quests.instruction: We wear this with two long legs that go all the way to our ankles. It is NOT your shoes. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They cover both of your legs, all the way down!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Pants cover both your legs to keep them warm and safe!
quests.funFact: Pants usually have a waistband held up by a belt or elastic.

quests.instruction: We wear this instead of dress shoes when we want to move fast, but it is not your tie. What is it?
quests.hint: They have bouncy, cushioned soles.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Sneakers have bouncy soles that make running and jumping comfortable!
quests.funFact: Sneakers provide excellent support and traction for running and jumping.

quests.instruction: We wear this instead of pants, with a shirt on top. It is NOT your shorts. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It hangs down from your waist!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Skirt hangs down from your waist and can swish as you walk!
quests.funFact: Did you know? skirts are garments that hang from the waist and leave the legs open.

quests.instruction: We wear this before we go outside to build a snowman. It is also worn to keep each finger warm and toasty, but it is NOT your sunglasses. What is it?
quests.hint: Think about this: Each finger gets its very own little space.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Gloves keep every finger warm and toasty in cold weather!
quests.funFact: Did you know? gloves have separate spots for each of your fingers.

quests.instruction: We wear this that we wrap around and around before going outside. It is NOT your underwear. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It wraps around your neck!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Scarf wraps around your neck to keep it warm and cozy!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a scarf is wrapped around the neck to keep the winter chill away.

quests.instruction: We wear this on our feet at the beach in summer. It is also worn with open straps that let our toes feel the breeze, but it is NOT your socks. What is it?
quests.hint: Hint: They are perfect for a hot, sunny beach day.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Sandals have open straps that let your feet stay cool in the sun!
quests.funFact: The oldest known sandals were discovered in a cave and are over 10,000 years old.

quests.instruction: We wear this when snow is falling outside our window. It is also worn to stay toasty warm on the coldest days of winter, but it is NOT your windbreaker. What is it?
quests.hint: Think about this: You wear this over all your other clothes.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Coat is thick and warm, worn over everything else in cold weather!
quests.funFact: Did you know? coats are made of thick materials to keep you warm in the winter.

quests.instruction: We wear this under a sweater or jacket to stay extra warm. It is NOT your hoodie. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It covers your chest, tummy, and back!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Shirt covers your chest and back to keep your top half comfy!
quests.funFact: The cuffs of a shirt usually have buttons to keep them tight around the wrist.

quests.instruction: We wear this over our shirt when the house feels chilly. It is also worn on a cool autumn day before winter arrives, but it is NOT your vest. What is it?
quests.hint: Think about this: You pull this over your head.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Sweater is soft and warm, perfect for chilly days indoors or out!
quests.funFact: Did you know? sweaters are usually knitted from wool or cotton yarn.

quests.instruction: We wear this that comes in matching pairs of two. It is also worn before we put our shoes on in the morning, but it is NOT your slippers. What is it?
quests.hint: Think about this: You wear two, one for each foot.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Socks keep your feet warm and make your shoes comfortable!
quests.funFact: Did you know? socks absorb sweat and keep your feet from getting blisters.

quests.instruction: We wear this on our head with a curved brim in the front. It is also worn with a soft, rounded top and no floppy edges, but it is NOT your hat. What is it?
quests.hint: Hint: Some people flip these around backward for fun.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Cap has a curved front brim that shades your eyes from the sun!
quests.funFact: A cap can be adjusted in the back to perfectly fit your head.

quests.instruction: We wear this instead of sandals with lots of straps, for easy beach days. It is also worn with just one strap that fits between our big toe and the next, but it is NOT your boots. What is it?
quests.hint: A single strap fits between just two toes!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Flip-Flops have one simple strap and slide on fast for easy beach days!
quests.funFact: Flip-flops are the perfect footwear for walking on a sandy beach.

quests.instruction: What do we call the feature that some jeans have four of, two in front and two in back? It is not your snowsuit!
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is a small feature, not something you would wear by itself!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Pocket is a small pouch sewn in for holding coins, toys, or notes!
quests.funFact: Jeans usually have exactly five pockets, including a tiny one for pocket watches.

quests.instruction: What do we call the strip we press together to fasten, and pull apart to open? It is not your cuff!
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It makes a satisfying ripping sound!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Velcro is a fuzzy fastener that sticks together with a satisfying rip!
quests.funFact: Many kids' shoes use Velcro instead of shoelaces because it's much faster.

quests.instruction: We wear this with a soft hood we can pull up over our head. It is also worn when we want a warm top with a hood attached, but it is NOT your t-shirt. What is it?
quests.hint: Hint: You can pull the hood up over your hair.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Hoodie has a warm hood attached that you can pull up over your head!
quests.funFact: Hoodies are extremely popular for staying warm on a chilly day.

quests.instruction: We wear this on our hands when it is extra freezing outside. It is also worn on the very coldest days, warmer than regular gloves, but it is NOT your sunglasses. What is it?
quests.hint: Hint: They are even warmer than regular gloves.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Mittens keep your fingers snuggled together, which makes them extra warm!
quests.funFact: Mittens are perfect for playing in the snow or building a snowman.

quests.instruction: We wear this instead of long pants when the weather is warm. It is also worn when we run and play outside in the heat, but it is NOT your skirt. What is it?
quests.hint: Think about this: They stop above your knees.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Shorts keep your legs cool and free to move on hot days!
quests.funFact: Did you know? shorts are perfect for summer because they keep your legs cool.

quests.instruction: What do we call the piece that can be round, square, shiny, or shaped like an animal? It is not your sleeve!
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is small and round!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Button is a small piece that pushes through a hole to close your clothes!
quests.funFact: A shirt usually has buttons all the way down the front.

quests.instruction: We wear this that is thinner and smoother than leggings. It is also worn before ballet class, snug from our waist to our toes, but it is NOT your pants. What is it?
quests.hint: They cover your legs AND your feet, all in one!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Tights cover your legs and feet in one thin, stretchy piece for warmth!
quests.funFact: Ballerinas wear tights so they can stretch and dance comfortably.

quests.instruction: We wear this that is thick, fluffy, and perfect for lazy mornings. It is also worn right after we towel off, before we get fully dressed, but it is NOT your swimsuit. What is it?
quests.hint: You wear this right after a warm bath!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Bathrobe is thick and fluffy, worn to stay warm right after a bath!
quests.funFact: Bathrobes usually tie closed with a soft fabric belt around the waist.

quests.instruction: What do we call the fastener that can get stuck if a piece of fabric gets caught inside? It is not your collar!
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It has a row of tiny teeth!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Zipper has tiny teeth that lock together in one smooth pull to close clothes!
quests.funFact: If a zipper gets stuck, rubbing soap on the teeth can help it slide again.

quests.instruction: What is the name for the folded part of a shirt that circles our neck? It is also the edge of a shirt that a button often closes at the top, but it is NOT your sleeve!
quests.hint: Think about this: It circles around your neck.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Collar is the folded edge of a shirt that circles your neck!
quests.funFact: A dog also wears a collar around its neck to hold its name tag!

quests.instruction: What do we call the strings that can come undone and need tying again while we run? It is not your sleeve!
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are long strings, not a whole shoe!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Shoelaces are the strings that tie into a bow to keep your shoes snug!
quests.funFact: Before shoelaces, shoes were fastened with buckles or buttons.

quests.instruction: What do we call the part we push up when we want to wash our hands without getting wet? It is not your zipper!
quests.hint: Here's a clue: This one is a small detail, not a full garment!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Cuff is the end of a sleeve that circles snugly around your wrist!
quests.funFact: Cuffs are reinforced with extra fabric so they don't wear out easily.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this that clips onto the front and back of our trousers, not your gloves. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They do the same job as a belt, but differently.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Suspenders clip over your shoulders to hold your pants up without a belt!
quests.funFact: They form an 'X' or 'Y' shape on the person's back.

quests.instruction: We wear this with a tall, snug collar that reaches all the way up our neck. It is also worn on the coldest days, when even our neck needs covering, but it is NOT your sweater. What is it?
quests.hint: Think about this: It hugs your neck snugly, like a little tube.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Turtleneck has a tall collar that covers your neck for extra warmth!
quests.funFact: They became very popular in fashion during the 1950s and 60s.

quests.instruction: We wear this with a fun picture or pattern printed on the front. It is also worn on a warm day when we do not need long sleeves, but it is NOT your shirt. What is it?
quests.hint: Think about this: It simply pulls over your head, no buttons needed.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your T-Shirt has short sleeves and pulls over your head easily!
quests.funFact: Did you know? t-shirts get their name because they are shaped like a capital letter 'T'.

quests.instruction: We wear this that opens all the way down the front with buttons. It is also worn over a T-shirt when the classroom feels a little chilly, but it is NOT your hoodie. What is it?
quests.hint: Think about this: You can leave it open or button it up.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Cardigan opens down the front with buttons, making it easy to put on!
quests.funFact: They were named after a British military commander, the Earl of Cardigan.

quests.instruction: What is the name for the soft, floppy part attached at the back of a jacket's neck? It is also the part of a hoodie that gives the hoodie its very name, but it is NOT your cuff!
quests.hint: Think about this: You pull it up over your hair.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Hood is the part that pulls up over your head to keep rain off!
quests.funFact: Historical cloaks almost always featured a large, deep hood.

quests.instruction: We wear this that farmers and painters often wear to protect their clothes. It is also worn instead of regular pants, with pockets on the chest too, but it is NOT your pants. What is it?
quests.hint: They have straps that go over your shoulders!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Overalls have shoulder straps and a front panel, so they never need a belt!
quests.funFact: They usually feature a large chest pocket for holding tools.
